sources.title: ModelScope Explained: Alibaba's Model Hub for Qwen Downloads
sources.snippet: ModelScope (魔搭): Alibaba's Open Model Hub for Qwen and Beyond ModelScope (魔搭) is the open-source model hub built by Alibaba Cloud, the same company behind the qwen by alibaba model family — often called "the Chinese Hugging Face." It hosts models, datasets and demo apps, and according to Alibaba Cloud's official blog, it's one of the two official places to download Qwen ...
